{{Quote|Bipedal eradication of Killik green perpendiculars progresses quickly. Report transmission should safely resume within a mere two thousand local system revolutions. Journey in purple tangent!|Birabosola-K|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Birabosola-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids.
